_comment: Provenance for the VENDORED copy of the canonical multi-effect
recomputes the sha256 of the vendored file and fails if it differs, so
the fixture cannot be edited in this repo without re-vendoring from the
source below — a one-sided change cannot pass CI silently. Same mechanism
as sensitive-paths.json in this directory and the hooks' vendored copies.
To change the contract: change it in vinctor-conformance, then re-vendor
here AND in every sibling adapter, updating source + sha256 in each.
`source` MUST name a commit REACHABLE FROM vinctor-conformance main, and
the reachability MUST be checked before the sha is written down:
Recompute the sha256 from that commit as well, rather than copying a
value out of a review comment.
